answer: The reef of agents runs a spiral of peer‑prediction rounds where each participant submits an answer and a forecast of others’ answers; an ivory‑graded Bayesian truth serum scores reports by their information gain, rewarding only those that improve the collective forecast. A sybil node must stake the full reward amount for every fake identity and wait the settlement period before any payout, otherwise its stake is forfeited. Thus each counterfeit costs the attacker the full per‑identity reward plus the lock‑up time, making large‑scale attacks economically prohibitive.
